descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S28 Haiku times out during Generate on a long note: Mistral gets what is left of the 30 s budget — a complete note or an explicit failure, never a cut-off note; Haiku failing at 9.5 s vs 10.5 s decides the second try

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • T3 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s (TFA-94422 AC 7; UAT 3.5)
  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U8 Each run logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total, so a slow run can be traced to the AI service or to the app (UAT 3.5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Local stack with the delay seam S09 needs (Haiku hangs until its 20 s attempt deadline, then AbortError); for the pair, the same seam making Haiku fail as a temporary error after 9.5 s and after 10.5 s; Mistral answers normally

When Generate a note for each long fixture (Hospital H&P, Nursing Home admission) with the hang seam; then generate TC-14 H-01 once with Haiku failing at 9.5 s and once at 10.5 s

Then Long fixtures: a complete note from Mistral that carries the last dictated sentence, or an explicit failure with the dictation kept, never a note cut off mid-section; the notes.generateNote row has providerMs ≥ 20000 and durationMs − providerMs ≤ about 2000. Pair: at 9.5 s Haiku is asked a second time before Mistral (3 attempts); …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Long fixtures: a returned note mustInclude 'lipase' / 'Monday' (the last dictated sentence) and the 'Assessment' / 'Plan' content, or the call fails with the dictation kept; a returned note missing the last sentence = Fail. An explicit failure is recorded and judged against Q14 (self-review item D). providerMs / durationMs as in S09 (U8). …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

Not judged: the Haiku-timeout-during-Generate case on a long note needs the Haiku-hang proxy on a private backend plus Generate allowed locally, which waits for Quinn's OK.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-other.

Haiku times out during Generate on a long note: Mistral gets what is left of the 30 s budget — a complete note or an explicit failure, never a cut-off note; Haiku failing at 9.5 s vs 10.5 s decides the second try

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-other: status blocked in aicheck-other/results.json → blocked (blocked).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): Fault backend + proxy: H-L1 and N-L1 with Haiku hanging to its 20 s cap (complete note carrying the last dictated sentence, or explicit failure; row providerMs >= 20000, durationMs - providerMs <= ~2000); pair TC-14 H-01 with Haiku answering 429 after 9.5 s and after 10.5 s, attempt count from the proxy's per-request log (record-only, Q4). — Two gates: fault-ai (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL / AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME are deployment env vars; `convex env set` is forbidden by CLAUDE.md even on a private backend, fault-stack.sh refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1) AND generate (generateNote is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json 'forbidden: generate', dev only); the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1, set only after Quinn's OK.) Built and harness-checked; the run waits for Quinn's OK on both.

Detail:

Two blockers: (1) fault-ai - the seam is a deployment env var and needs `convex env set`, which CLAUDE.md forbids (no exception for a private backend; fault-stack.sh refuses without QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1); (2) generate - the runner calls ai/notes:generateNote, which capabilities.json forbids locally (the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1). Both need Quinn's OK. Also needs the hang / delayed-429 seam (bedrock-proxy.mjs via AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME on the private backend, same env-set gate). Built: note-ai.ts OAT03-S28-long / OAT03-S28-pair-<ms> (complete note with the last dictated sentence or an explicit failure; providerMs >= 20000; attempt count recorded from the proxy log and the backend's '[ai] … answered after N attempt(s)' log line, record-only per Q4). Not run.

Evidence: 0 attached; 3 not attached:

  • scripts/aicheck-other/note-ai.ts — outside the local run folder, not attached
  • scripts/aicheck-other/bedrock-proxy.mjs — outside the local run folder, not attached
  • scripts/aicheck-other/fault-stack.sh — outside the local run folder, not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B note-ai with a local-only delay seam (Haiku hangs to its 20 s cap, or fails after 9.5 s / 10.5 s; fault-ai) and the Convex log for the attempt count.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
